html:
When someone sings a song out of tune, you can still catch the lyrics and even fill in the melody in your head, provided you know the song well. That is your brain helping your ears.

The brain is not the only helper: vision also plays a part in hearing, as Ziyu Acoustics discussed in its previous post on face masks and speech. This video from AsapSCIENCE looks at more of the surprising things the brain does when we listen.

Video: AsapSCIENCE, shared by Fanyu Meng on Ziyu Acoustics. See also Which face mask is kindest to speech?
